thread:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — spotted ~50 accounts in onboarding with very sparse CRM data, healthscore tanking and playbook firing hard.
CS Bot: alert: playbook:onboard-stalled detected 47 accounts (compactness < 0.3). sample: https://redwood.prod/alerts/1746453210 :warning:
Jon R: ugh. is this coming from legacy import or new signups?
Maya K: looks like a mix; ~60% from legacy CSV imports, 40% organic. common fields missing: 'product_team', 'time_zone', 'seats'.
Priya S: can we query a sample quickly? asked for small SQL.
Jon R: dropping sample:
```sql
SELECT account_id, created_at, (
  (CASE WHEN product_team IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) +
  (CASE WHEN time_zone IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) +
  (CASE WHEN seats IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
) AS filled_count
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE stage = 'onboarding'
AND created_at > '2024-12-01'
ORDER BY filled_count ASC
LIMIT 50;
```
Priya S: thanks. propose we use a 'compactness' metric = filled_count / required_fields_count and gate heavy playbooks when compactness < 0.25. avoid blasting customers with nudges when profile is incomplete.
Maya K: yes — current heavy_nudge playbook triggers on 'last_touch > 7d' which is too noisy. compactness gate would reduce false positives.
Priya S: rough playbook rule draft:
```json
{"id":"gate_compactness_v1","when":"compactness < 0.25","then":"suppress:heavy_nudge","owner":"cs-ops","notes":"Enable lightweight checklist nudge + admin task"}
```
Jon R: can we also auto-create a CS task to request missing fields instead of emailing? lightweight checklist improves conversion.
Maya K: agreed. action items:
- Liam N: write backfill script to add 'import_source' tag + compute compactness for historical accounts — due Fri 2025-06-13
- Priya S: update playbook config to add compactness gate and create 'light-touch' checklist flow — due Mon 2025-06-16
- Jon R: add metric to Console: % accounts suppressed by compactness per cohort — due Tue 2025-06-17
Liam N: got it, I'll start on the script now. ping if sample exports needed.
Priya S: will PR playbook change in git (cc @eng-ops).
Maya K: thanks all :thumbsup: let's avoid another noisy nudge weekend.
CS Bot: noted: follow-ups captured. playbook change request created #PR-3948.
Liam N: quick note: may need a small migration to compute compactness column; will post ETA after spike test.
Maya K: cool — mark as 'ops-huddle:compactness' and we'll sync in tomorrow's stand.
